newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: New head for Malaysia investment fund PNB - paper.
newsitem.headline: New head for Malaysia investment fund PNB - paper.

text.p: Former chief secretary to the Malaysian government, Ahmad Sarji Abdul Hamid, will be the new chairman of the state investment fund Permodalan National Bhd (PNB), Business Times said on Thursday.
Ahmad, 55, will replace outgoing chairman Ismail Mohamed Ali, who is being appointed an adviser to PNB, the daily quoted sources as saying.
PNB could not be immediately reached for comment.
PNB reported a 15.6 percent rise in pretax profit to 1.156 billion ringgit for the year ended December 31, 1995, on an operating revenue of 1.957 billion.
During 1995, the fund invested 2.613 billion ringgit in shares, bonds, warrants and transferable rights in the local market.
